body: Nah who remember this Never forget when Lil Uzi Vert @liluzivert went live at 5 a. m. in New York and spent nearly 10 minutes breakdancing in the street without saying a word… The random livestream happened during the Eternal Atake era, when Uzi was known for popping up online at all hours and doing the most unexpected things. Fans tuned in as the clip spread across social media, turning a quiet NYC street into one of Uzi’s most memorable late-night moments.
